audio.t: Good morning. I'd like to check in for the flight to Lisbon. Here's my passport.
Thank you, Ms. Duarte. I see you have one suitcase. Let me put it on the scale. Hmm, it's twenty-six kilograms, and the limit is twenty-three.
Oh no. I bought some gifts in Singapore, and I didn't realize they were so heavy.
You can pay an extra fee of fifty dollars, or you can move some items into your carry-on bag.
My carry-on is already pretty full. Is there a place nearby where I can mail a package home?
Yes, there's a postal counter across from Gate 3. It closes at noon, so you have about forty minutes.
Great. I'll take out some books and mail them. I'll come back after that.

questions.q: What is the problem?
questions.explain: Nhân viên nói hành lý nặng 26 kg trong khi giới hạn là 23 kg.

questions.q: What does the man suggest the woman do?
options: Pay a fee or move some items
questions.explain: Anh nói 'pay an extra fee of fifty dollars, or move some items into your carry-on bag'. Các lựa chọn khác không được nhắc tới.

questions.q: What will the woman probably do next?
questions.explain: Cô nói 'I'll take out some books and mail them'. Cô chưa chọn trả phí nên (B) sai.

audio.t: Daniel, Hiro, thanks for coming. The mayor's interview was scheduled for Thursday, but his office just asked to move it to Friday.
That's a problem. Our print deadline for Saturday's edition is Friday at six p.m.
Well, I could write the draft in advance, using the background research, and then add the quotes right after the interview.
That could work. Hiro, how many photos will you need?
Just two. I can take them right after the interview, before the mayor's office closes.
Good. Then let's proceed. I'll let the mayor's assistant know.
Should we also tell the layout team about the possible delay?
Yes, I'll e-mail them this afternoon.

questions.q: What problem does the woman mention?
questions.explain: Cô nói văn phòng thị trưởng yêu cầu dời buổi phỏng vấn từ thứ Năm sang thứ Sáu.

questions.q: What does Daniel offer to do?
questions.explain: Daniel nói 'I could write the draft in advance'. Chụp ảnh là việc của Hiro.

questions.q: What will the woman do this afternoon?
options: Send an e-mail to the layout team
questions.explain: Cô kết luận 'I'll e-mail them this afternoon' (them = layout team).

audio.t: Hi, I'm interested in your weekly vegetable box. Do you deliver to the downtown area?
We do, every Wednesday and Saturday. The small box is twenty-two dollars and the large box is thirty-five.
And is everything organic?
All of it is grown without chemical pesticides. We just received our official organic certificate last month.
That's reassuring. I'd like the large box. Can I start next week?
Of course. Just fill out this form with your address and choose a delivery day. If you sign up for three months, you'll get one box free.
Great, I'll do that now, and I'll take the Saturday delivery.

questions.q: What is the man interested in?
questions.explain: Anh nói quan tâm 'your weekly vegetable box' và hỏi có giao đến khu trung tâm không.

questions.q: What does the woman say about the farm's products?
options: They are sold only in stores.
They are grown without chemical pesticides.
They are cheaper than at supermarkets.
questions.explain: Cô nói 'All of it is grown without chemical pesticides'. Không có thông tin về giá so với siêu thị.

questions.q: How can the man get a free box?
options: By signing up for three months
questions.explain: Cô nói 'If you sign up for three months, you'll get one box free'. Chọn thứ Bảy chỉ là lựa chọn ngày giao.

audio.t: Hello, Lakeside Water Services. How can I help you?
Hi, my water bill this month is almost double what I usually pay, and I haven't changed anything at home.
I'm sorry to hear that. Let me look at your account... It shows a steady increase in usage over the last three weeks. Is it possible you have a leak?
Hmm, I did notice a wet patch in the yard last week, but I thought it was from the rain.
That might be the problem. We can send a technician to inspect your pipes. It's free of charge, and the earliest slot is tomorrow between ten and noon.
That works. I'll be home. And what about the bill?
If a leak is confirmed, you can apply for an adjustment, and I'll e-mail you the form.

questions.q: Why is the man calling?
options: To move to a new house
questions.explain: Anh nói hóa đơn nước 'almost double' mức thường lệ.

questions.q: What did the man notice last week?
options: A strange noise from the pipes
A wet area in his yard
questions.explain: Anh nói 'I did notice a wet patch in the yard last week'.

questions.q: What will the woman send by e-mail?
questions.explain: Cô nói 'I'll e-mail you the form' để xin điều chỉnh hóa đơn (adjustment).

audio.t: Welcome to Tech Haven. Looking for anything in particular?
Yes, I bought this wireless speaker last week, and the sound keeps cutting out. I'd like to exchange it.
Do you have the receipt? Let me check. Hmm, this was purchased on the fifth, so it's within our fourteen-day exchange period. But the model you bought is out of stock now.
Excuse me, Kevin. I just got a delivery of that model this morning. It's in the back.
Oh, that's great, Ms. Tanaka. Then I'll bring one out for you.
Thank you. Could I also get a case for it?
Of course. Cases are on the shelf near the register, and they're twenty percent off this week.

questions.q: What is the woman's problem?
options: The speaker is the wrong color.
questions.explain: Khách nói 'the sound keeps cutting out'.

questions.q: What does Ms. Tanaka say she received?
questions.explain: Bà nói 'I just got a delivery of that model this morning', tức hàng mới về.

questions.q: What does the woman ask about?
questions.explain: Cô hỏi 'Could I also get a case for it?'.

audio.t: Good afternoon, Seabreeze Resort. How can I assist you?
Hi, I'm in the Palm Villa. We'd like to book a snorkeling trip for tomorrow, if there's still space.
Let me see. The morning trip is full, but there are a few spots on the afternoon departure at two o'clock. It lasts about three hours and includes equipment.
Two o'clock should be fine. There are four of us, including two children aged nine and eleven.
Children under ten need to be accompanied by an adult in the water, and we require a signed permission form. I'll have it sent to your villa.
Thank you. Also, is lunch included?
No, but you could have lunch at the beach café first. Show your room key, and you'll get a ten percent discount.

questions.q: What does the man want to do?
questions.explain: Anh muốn đặt 'a snorkeling trip' cho ngày mai.

questions.q: What does the woman say about the morning trip?
questions.explain: Cô nói 'The morning trip is full'.

questions.q: What will the woman send to the villa?
questions.explain: Cô nói cần 'a signed permission form. I'll have it sent to your villa'.

audio.t: Thanks for joining. As you know, we have five new hires starting Monday, and I'd like to finalize the orientation schedule.
The IT department can set up laptops and accounts on Friday afternoon, so everything will be ready.
I'll prepare the welcome packets. Do we want to include the revised employee handbook? It was updated last month.
Yes, please. And can someone arrange a lunch for the new employees on their first day?
I'll take care of that. I'll book a table at the restaurant near the office.
One more thing. Two of the new hires are relocating from other cities. Should we send them parking information?
Good point. I'll e-mail them today.

questions.q: What are the speakers preparing for?
questions.explain: Họ bàn về 'five new hires starting Monday' và lịch định hướng (orientation).

questions.q: What does the second man say he will prepare?
questions.explain: M2 nói 'I'll prepare the welcome packets'. Laptop là việc của phòng IT do M nói.

questions.q: What will the woman do today?
questions.explain: Cô nói 'I'll e-mail them today' sau khi đồng ý gửi thông tin chỗ đậu xe. Đặt nhà hàng là việc của người đàn ông thứ nhất.

audio.t: Hello, I'm planning a trip to Bangkok for my parents' anniversary, and I'd like to book flights and a hotel.
Congratulations to them. When would you like to travel?
Around the second week of October, for about ten days.
October is the beginning of the dry season, so it's a popular time. Prices go up by about fifteen percent compared with September. I'd recommend booking at least two months ahead.
I see. Are there any packages that include airport transfers?
Yes. Our Silk Route package includes flights, six nights at a four-star hotel, and transfers. I can print the details for you.
Please do. I'd also like to discuss it with my sister before I decide.

questions.q: What is the occasion for the trip?
questions.explain: Người đàn ông nói chuyến đi 'for my parents' anniversary'.

questions.q: Why are prices higher in October?
options: It is the start of the dry season.
questions.explain: Cô nói 'October is the beginning of the dry season, so it's a popular time'.

questions.q: What will the woman probably do next?
questions.explain: Cô nói 'I can print the details for you' và anh đáp 'Please do'. Anh còn muốn bàn với chị gái nên chưa thanh toán.

audio.t: Team, we've had reports of a power outage on Maple Avenue since about seven this morning.
Is it affecting the whole neighborhood?
About two hundred homes. Preliminary reports suggest a transformer was damaged by the storm last night.
I'm at the depot now. We have a spare transformer in the truck, but we'll need a crane to install it.
I'll request one from the city's equipment unit. How soon can you get there?
We can be on-site by nine. Should we notify the residents?
Yes, I'll send text messages with an estimated restoration time of noon, and post an update on our Web site.

questions.q: What has caused the problem?
questions.explain: Cô nói 'a transformer was damaged by the storm last night'.

questions.q: What does the woman say she will request?
questions.explain: M2 cần cần cẩu, cô đáp 'I'll request one from the city's equipment unit' (one = a crane).

questions.q: What will the woman do for residents?
questions.explain: Cô nói 'I'll send text messages with an estimated restoration time'.

audio.t: Mr. Costa, thanks for stopping by. We've reviewed your manuscript on regional farming traditions, and we'd like to publish it.
That's wonderful news. When would it be released?
We're aiming for next spring, but there's a catch. Our editor suggests cutting the third chapter, since it overlaps with the second.
Well, I'd rather keep some of it. Perhaps I could shorten it by half and add more photographs instead?
That's a good compromise. I'll check with the design department about the cost of printing color images.
Fine. Should I send the revised chapter by the end of the month?
Yes, and I'll e-mail you the contract this week.

questions.q: What does the woman say about the manuscript?
options: It is too expensive to print.
questions.explain: Cô nói 'we'd like to publish it'. Chỉ đề nghị cắt một chương, không bị từ chối.

questions.q: What does the man propose?
options: Shortening a chapter and adding photos
questions.explain: Anh nói 'shorten it by half and add more photographs instead'.

questions.q: What will the woman do this week?
questions.explain: Cô nói 'I'll e-mail you the contract this week'.

audio.t: Thanks for meeting, everyone. The corporate retreat for Brightwave Consulting arrives next Thursday, with about sixty guests.
The conference room is ready, but their organizer asked for a second projector for breakout sessions.
And on the catering side, six guests have food allergies, mostly nuts and shellfish. I'll prepare separate menus, but I need the final list by Monday.
I'll ask the organizer to confirm. Anything else?
They'd like an outdoor activity on Friday afternoon, but the forecast shows rain.
Let's offer a cooking class in the kitchen as an alternative. Chef, would that work?
Sure, I can host up to twenty people at a time, so we'd need three sessions.

questions.q: What are the speakers discussing?
questions.explain: Họ chuẩn bị cho đoàn 'corporate retreat' khoảng 60 khách sắp đến vào thứ Năm tới.

questions.q: What did the organizer request?
questions.explain: Người phụ nữ nói 'their organizer asked for a second projector for breakout sessions'.

questions.q: What does the man suggest for Friday afternoon?
questions.explain: Dự báo có mưa nên anh đề nghị 'a cooking class in the kitchen as an alternative'.

audio.t: Hi, Sandra. I wanted to ask about the parental leave policy. My wife and I are expecting a baby in March.
Congratulations, Tom! Employees who've been with us for more than a year get twelve weeks of paid leave. You joined two years ago, so you qualify.
That's good to know. Do I need to submit anything?
Yes, you'll need to fill out a request form at least thirty days before your leave starts, and attach a note from your doctor.
I see. Can I split the leave into two parts?
Yes, as long as your supervisor approves. I suggest you talk to Mr. Weber first and then bring me the signed form.
Will do. I'll speak with him this afternoon.

questions.q: What does the man ask about?
questions.explain: Anh hỏi về 'the parental leave policy' (chế độ nghỉ thai sản/chăm con).

questions.q: What must the man attach to the form?
questions.explain: Cô nói 'attach a note from your doctor'.

questions.q: What will the man do this afternoon?
questions.explain: Anh nói 'I'll speak with him this afternoon', him = Mr. Weber, người giám sát của anh.

audio.t: Excuse me, my connecting flight to Denver has been canceled because of snow. The screen says to see an agent.
I'm sorry, ma'am. May I see your ticket? Let me check. The next available flight to Denver departs tomorrow at eight fifteen in the morning.
Tomorrow? I have a presentation at ten tomorrow morning.
Then I could put you on a flight through Chicago leaving in forty minutes. You'd arrive in Denver at nine thirty tonight, but you'd need to hurry because the gate is far away.
That works. Will my luggage be transferred automatically?
Yes, it will. Here's your new boarding pass. Gate B22, and I'd recommend taking the shuttle train.

questions.q: Why was the woman's flight canceled?
questions.explain: Cô nói chuyến bay bị hủy 'because of snow' (tuyết = thời tiết xấu).

questions.q: Why is the woman concerned about tomorrow's flight?
options: She needs to meet a friend.
questions.explain: Cô nói 'I have a presentation at ten tomorrow morning', nên chuyến 8:15 sáng mai không kịp.

questions.q: What does the man recommend?
questions.explain: Anh nói 'I'd recommend taking the shuttle train' vì cổng bay ở xa.
